title: Why Two Cicada Broods Just Shared The Same Year
hook: 13 and 17 just found their one shared year, in your backyard.
closing: So... will you still be around in 2245?
question: Which cicada brood year were you born into?

segments.say: Two cicada broods, on totally different clocks, both happened to emerge together this year.
These two cicada broods only line up once every 221 years.
Prime habitat can hit 1.5 million cicadas per acre when both broods swarm together at once.
